title: I SURVIVED The Most Extreme Places On Earth #shorts
description:
Three teams dropped into a jungle, a desert, and Antarctica - first to the helicopter wins $100,000 for their moms.
No gear, no crew, just a map and a race where everything tries to kill you.
#Shorts #ExtremeSurvival #SurvivalRace #MrBeast
